# PAPERCUT (17 · papercut)

A riso zine studio in torn paper — every ragged edge is a generated clip-path.

- **Technique:** TORN CLIP-PATHS
- **Tags:** zine, handmade, collage, riso, indie, craft, playful, paper
- **Best for:** indie publishers; print shops; creative studios; craft brands
- **Fonts:** Caveat, Archivo, Courier Prime
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@500;700&family=Archivo:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,800;1,400&family=Courier+Prime:ital@0;1&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #d9c7a8 · #ff4b33 · #2244cc
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/papercut/` (Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css, torn.ts, zart.ts)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* papercut — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --kraft: #d9c7a8;
  --kraft2: #cbb691;
  --cream: #f5eede;
  --ink: #2a2620;
  --ink-soft: #6d5f4d;
  --tape: #ffebaa;

  /* Riso ink drums */
  --riso-red: #ff4b33;
  --riso-blue: #2244cc;
  --riso-green: #00a06a;
  --riso-pink: #ff7bac;

  /* Zine cover papers (see Zine.paper in content.ts) */
  --peach: #ffe3d6;
  --sky: #dbe4ff;
  --blush: #ffd9ec;
  --white: #fff;

  --hand: "Caveat", cursive;
  --arch: "Archivo", sans-serif;
  --type: "Courier Prime", monospace;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  --spring: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `torn.ts`
  - `tearEdges(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Give each element a ragged `clip-path` polygon. Elements are torn in document order from one shared Park–Miller (16807) sequence.
- `zart.ts`
  - `zineArt(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Fill every `[data-zart]` element with its two-color riso cover drawing.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<br>/<a>/<i> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Cover drawing for a zine (generated SVG in zart.ts). */
export type ZineArt = 'flower' | 'bus' | 'puddle' | 'fridge';

/** Paper stock for a zine cover; maps to a `--<name>` token (`cream` → `--cream`). */
export type ZinePaper = 'cream' | 'peach' | 'sky' | 'blush';

export interface HeroLine {
  text: string;
  /** Riso ink for the line; omit for plain ink. */
  tone?: 'red' | 'blue';
  /** Print a misregistered blue ghost copy behind the line. */
  ghost?: boolean;
}

/** A scrap of paper pinned around the hero collage; offsets are CSS lengths. */
export interface Floater {
  text: string;
  /** Tilt in degrees. */
  rotate: number;
  top?: string;
  right?: string;
  bottom?: string;
  left?: string;
}

export interface Zine {
  /** Small typewriter line on the cover, e.g. "ISSUE Nº2 · 2ND PRINT". */
  numberLabel: string;
  titleHtml: string;
  paper: ZinePaper;
  art: ZineArt;
  /** Handwritten tagline under the cover. */
  kind: string;
  /** Price tag under the cover (or "SOLD OUT"). */
  price: string;
  /** Resting tilt in degrees. */
  tilt: number;
}

export interface SectionTitle {
  headingHtml: string;
  /** Handwritten aside next to the heading. */
  hand: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo label in nav + footer; wrap the accented part in <i>. */
  logoHtml: string;
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Stacked lines of the big collage headline. */
    lines: HeroLine[];
    handHtml: string;
    floaters: Floater[];
    /** Round sticker at the corner of the collage. */
    stickerHtml: string;
  };
  issues: SectionTitle & { id: string; zines: Zine[] };
  about: SectionTitle & {
    id: string;
    /** Paragraphs of the typed letter. */
    paragraphsHtml: string[];
    signatureHtml: string;
  };
  stockists: SectionTitle & {
    id: string;
    shops: { name: string; place: string }[];
  };
  submit: {
    id: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
}
```
